headline: [Vietnam stocks] Liquidity surged but selling pressure was strong, mixed close, NVL and PNJ break losing streak
summary: The Ho Chi Minh VN-Index fell 0.22% to 1,735.09 points in a mixed session. High oil prices, inflation concerns and rising US Treasury yields weighed on risk sentiment.
why: The VN-Index tracks the largest listed companies on the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange, the main equity benchmark for Vietnam.
